$comment: Plugin pack: opencode-voice — local speech-to-text (whisper.cpp via sox) + optional Piper TTS (github.com/renjfk/opencode-voice). Unlike MCP packs, this pack carries a 'cli' key: deploy/merge-packs.mjs deep-merges it into the v2 global client config ~/.config/opencode/cli.json (--client-config), merging the plugins list BY PACKAGE NAME in v2 object form ({package, options}) so other plugins are preserved (idempotent re-runs replace in place). --tui-config is the explicit v1-compat fallback (writes tui.json with legacy [name, options] tuples). Host prereqs (sox, whisper-cli, whisper model) are handled by setup.sh install_voice / setup.ps1 note when this pack is requested. Normalization defaults to a local Ollama endpoint — edit endpoint/model in the deployed cli.json to point at any OpenAI-compatible API (Anthropic, OpenAI, LM Studio, llama.cpp); omit apiKeyEnv for unauthenticated endpoints. Not useful inside Docker (no microphone): without a client-config flag the cli merge is skipped with a warning.
